data.narrative:
Nuclearn.ai is a Series A nuclear energy company founded by Bradley Fox and Jerrold Vincent that has raised $10.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a broader comp universe of 3 public companies (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private peers including Fuse Energy, Oklo, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, and General Matter operating in the nuclear energy sector.

Stage-progression methodology is the applicable triangulation approach here. Using total raised ($10.5M) as a proxy for current value and applying a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage advancement yields an implied valuation of $21M. This method accounts for expected value creation between funding rounds in the capital equipment and frontier-tech context. Peer-median valuation is not applicable due to insufficient narrow-set comparables within nuclear energy at the same stage and valuation tier; while four same-sector peers exist, fewer than three met the filtering criteria needed for reliable median extraction.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $18M (low) to $24M (high), with a median point of $21M. This single-method triangulation carries elevated uncertainty typical of frontier-stage private companies with limited public market precedent and sparse same-stage peer data. Key uncertainties include technology differentiation within the nuclear subsector, regulatory pathway clarity, and near-term capital requirements relative to peer benchmarks.
